name: MVANE YARD NATIVE
author: Alex Enkerli
description: mvane yard on VIBE FM, native: chords from any scale on the keys (qualities latched on the black keys, as Coral Flower's), an always-on recorder with loops and overdub, an arp on the DAW's grid, YARD and Clipper's 337 sounds, MPE. The FM-1 firmware's own code (github.com/Enkerli/mvane-yard).
